free_tier.stated: new accounts get a 7-day free trial with up to USD 20 of usage on Starter terms; a card is required to start the first machine and is not charged if cancelled within the week. Plans start at USD 20 a month and each plan fee becomes that month's usage credit

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

egress.terms: no egress allowance or overage price is on the pricing page; the plan credit covers machine time and disk. Network policy allows all, an allowlist or no internet, with optional residential exits billed separately per GB

interface_detail: REST API and CLI, per maritime.sh/llms.txt: "one REST API" and "the maritime CLI"
tooling: the provider documents TypeScript SDK (npm maritime-sdk), Python SDK (pip maritime) and the maritime CLI (npm maritime-cli), per maritime.sh/llms.txt

limits.value: the free offer is a 7-day trial capped at USD 20 of usage; at the cap machines stop until the paid plan starts and one free trial is allowed per card and per email

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented. Exceeds capacity threshold.

identity_cost.detail: a card is needed to start the first machine and is not charged during the 7-day trial; the signup form also offers Continue with Google and Continue with GitHub alongside email and password. One free trial per card and per email
